event_name: Date 30 October 2022 Time 14:46 2022 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
offence: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video from several angles. Gasly made a pass on Stroll at Turn 4, however in doing so he locked up and left the track at the exit of the turn, completing the pass off track. He thereby gained a lasting advantage.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
